Write the function described below.

entry checked_mul
params i16 i16
ret i16

Write a function checked_mul that takes two signed 16-bit numbers a and b and returns a * b as a
signed 16-bit number. If the product does not fit in a signed 16-bit number (-32768..32767), it must
stop with trap kind 1 (overflow).

Your program was refused: compiler: SYNTAX at line 6: expected '=', '[' or '(' after a name at statement start, found '1'
Reply with the corrected complete program in one fenced code block.
